name: Stitch
description: Put a redrawn crop back into the picture it was cut from (Crop to Mask). The crop is resized to its box and blended in through the mask, softened outward by Blend pixels, so no seam shows. Everything outside the box keeps the original's pixels exactly.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Image
inputs.description: The redrawn crop. It must have the crop's shape, to within 2%.

inputs.name: blend
inputs.label: Blend
inputs.description: How far the edge of the mask fades outward, in pixels of the picture.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.description: The mask to blend through, at the picture's size. Without one, the mask Crop to Mask was given.
